items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: but he's with Louie Russell then

ctx.x: Well Pops always did think a lot of me. He want -- he said Boy, come on in the band, but he's with Louie Russell then, so he wanted me in the band, and he said you should be here, you should be there, you should been -- so when I -- aw, I missing, when I did come to New York, I -- and got this room, I needed a job, I was hungry. They have no room, and I didn't have money to pay room rent, or anything, so somebody called me and gave me this job, I think it was four or five dollars, in the Village, and when I got…

they didn't -- well I had a tuxedo, but no one told me tuxedo, so I grabbed my trumpet and a dark suit and I ran on down there. So I got ready to get on the stand and the manager who ran the place, somebody, said Who are you?
